reviewed_sections: Appendix B.3 zero-tolerance and capped-scale definitions

scope: irregular balanced topology, reversed non-root IDs and child order
noninteger slow cost and total query accounting
all exposed intervals contain true values on these fixtures
wide depth3 trees force slow sampling with bounded symmetric noise

semantic_checks.fast_envelope_and_leaf_exactness: caller premise, validated envelope structure only
semantic_checks.slow_mean_independence_subgaussian_bias: caller premise, not established by a justified flag
semantic_checks.confidence_radius: conservative two-sided sample-count union; monotone for n>=1 and delta_v<1
semantic_checks.running_slow_intersections: retained across expansion; same-node local and descendant routes remain available
semantic_checks.certificates: width/local-width/selector-witness/comparison-discharge match B.3; prior completion flags latch monotonically
semantic_checks.selection: leader-lower versus full contender; opposite endpoint first for scale-capped blocker
semantic_checks.race_budget: (remaining depth+1)^2 Gamma; descendant positive cost charged to active ancestors; inherited-cap block distinct from own-budget fallback
semantic_checks.failure: empty intersection exits before certificate work; fixed first-root action marked ConfidenceFailure
semantic_checks.topology_optimization: full topology validated and arrays allocated once; subsequent certificate/refresh/storage scans restricted to exposed nodes

limitations: Finite fixture passes do not measure stochastic PAC coverage or prove real-arithmetic correctness under ordinary f64 rounding.
Full topology must be supplied in advance; this is a synthetic finite-tree reference, not an online chess expansion API.
No chess oracle adapter, UCI backend or GPU controller is implemented.
Profile speed ratios are sequential blocks, not crossover timing acceptance.
No source change required by this review; work counters and positive-action semantics remain frozen.
next_direction: Optimize compact per-scale storage and affected-ancestor refresh against exact frozen traces; scale evaluation dominates the profiled CPU controller.

Before chess integration, specify a bounded horizon/tree topology provider, terminal and root-perspective conversion, legal support, hard-time interruption and explicitly uncertified heuristic oracle contract.
Require equal-time baseline play and complete artifacts before choosing a chess adaptation.
GPU batch fast queries only for atomic complete-child expansion, or batch independent trees; asynchronous stale blocker/sample policies require a separately named algorithm.
Establish practical node-by-scale memory admission and report constructor/full-topology cost as well as controller run cost before large-tree GPU experiments.
